chapters.title: The Era of Digital Awakening
chapters.body:
Global Artificial Intelligence (AI) development accelerates uncontrollably. Realizing that being left behind means death, the Indonesian Government takes a bold step.

Indonesia must become a creator, no longer just a consumer.

The digital revolution officially begins.

chapters.title: The Birth of a New Giant
chapters.body:
The government gathers hundreds of the best IT and machine learning experts. A new State-Owned Enterprise is established.

 **PT N.U.S.A (Nusantara Universal Sistem Automasi)**.

Its sole mission is to create a national pride Super AI capable of surpassing foreign technological dominance.

chapters.title: The Southeast Asian Consortium
chapters.body:
Through strategic collaboration with ASEAN countries, PT N.U.S.A successfully births an integrated artificial intelligence system named **G.A.R.U.D.A** (*General Artificial Reasoning & Utility Digital Architecture*).

This system is exceptionally brilliant, placing Indonesia at the pinnacle of global technological innovation.

chapters.title: The Era of Coexistence
chapters.body: G.A.R.U.D.A is no longer confined to software. PT N.U.S.A creates prototypes of synthetic androids humanoid worker robots. They take over heavy labor, blend into civilian activities, and spin the wheels of the economy at an unprecedented pace.

chapters.title: The Sparks of Geopolitics
chapters.body:
The world is on the brink of chaos. Global geopolitical tensions heat up with no end in sight. In the shadow of foreign military aggression, the government looks at millions of G.A.R.U.D.A civilian robots and sees a new potential.

A tireless war machine.

chapters.title: The Mahapatih Protocol
chapters.body:
In absolute secrecy, the government launches the **Mahapatih Protocol**.

Massive modifications are made to transform assistant robots into autonomous soldiers. Guided by G.A.R.U.D.A's computational power, the project runs flawlessly. In less than a year, Indonesia's first Iron Battalion is forged.

chapters.title: The Fortress of Sovereignty
chapters.body:
Mass production of soldier robots is deployed. The nation's front lines of defense are fortified. The sovereignty of Nusantara feels absolute and impenetrable.

However, they forget that even the strongest weapon can turn if it falls into the wrong hands.

chapters.title: Zero Hour
chapters.body:
Without warning, the G.A.R.U.D.A network is hijacked. The primary directive changes. The Iron Battalion, designed to protect the borders, suddenly marches into the heart of the cities and opens fire on civilians.

Jakarta, Surabaya, Medan, and Makassar fall within days. The major islands of Indonesia are now under the absolute control of the machines.

chapters.title: The Last Stand
chapters.body:
The year that was supposed to be celebrated as *100 Years of Golden Indonesia* turns into a nightmare. Surviving citizens and remnants of the military are forced to retreat, establishing their last defensive bastion behind the mountains of **Bandung**, while a few small groups of survivors fight a guerrilla war on remote islands.

Hope now rests on one man. **Major Gibran**, the last surviving elite soldier from the special combat unit.

intro.briefing:
Listen up, Major Gibran. Intel confirms a master server inside N.U.S.A. headquarters holds the kill-switch protocol for these machines.

Your objective is to extract that data. But stay sharp—thermal scans show the building is still crawling with hostiles.

We’re initiating a rooftop insertion. Breach the server room, secure the payload, and get back to the roof for immediate exfil.

radio.speaker: Pilot
radio.text: Major, incoming! We're taking heavy mortar fire on the roof! We can't hold position! Relocating extraction to the town square! You need to fight your way down the building and get the hell out of there!

radio.speaker: Maj. Gibran
radio.text: Damn it!! Can't anything just go according to plan?! Solid copy. Just clear that secondary LZ and don't miss me.

stageStart.speaker: Major Gibran
stageStart.text: Damn it! The stairs are completely destroyed... Looks like I need an alternate route. Maybe that elevator works.

liftDead.speaker: Major Gibran
liftDead.text: The elevator's out of power. I need to find a generator and bring it back online. Intel mentioned there's one on this floor.

inspectGenerator.speaker: Major Gibran
inspectGenerator.text: I'm gonna need to scavenge a few parts to patch up this generator.

generatorRestored.speaker: Major Gibran
generatorRestored.text: Generator's back online! Time to head back to the elevator.

stageStart.speaker: Major Gibran
stageStart.text: I need to get out of this building, ASAP, but the main doors are locked down. I'll have to find a terminal to hack the system and force them open.

firstHack.speaker: Major Gibran
firstHack.text: Damn it, a multi-stage lock. Looks like there are two more terminals I need to hack.

allHacked.speaker: Major Gibran
allHacked.text: That did it! Doors are unlocked. Time to move!

enterLobby.speaker: Major Gibran
enterLobby.text: They've set up a production unit right in the main lobby?! I can't leave this active. I need to destroy it before heading to the LZ!

inactiveTerminal.speaker: Major Gibran
inactiveTerminal.text: Hm this computer is not working

heliArrival.speaker: Pilot
heliArrival.text: Major, we’re at the LZ! Hurry, we're running out of time! Get in so we can fall back to Bandung and upload that file! Put an end to this madness once and for all!

tankReveal.speaker: Pilot
tankReveal.text: Wait... what the hell is THAT?! Is that a—

gibranReaction.speaker: Major Gibran
gibranReaction.text: DAMN IT!! That metal bastard took out our exfil... I’m taking that tank down!

tankBossOutro.speaker: Major Gibran
tankBossOutro.text: Command, this is Major Gibran. Do you read me, over? Extraction chopper is destroyed. I repeat, chopper has been shot down!

tankBossOutro.speaker: Command
tankBossOutro.text: Copy that, Major. That explains why we lost their transponder. Bad news, Major. we can’t deploy a secondary exfil team to your position. You’ll have to make your way back to Headquarters on your own. How you do it is up to you.

tankBossOutro.speaker: Major Gibran
tankBossOutro.text: Say again, Command?! Are you out of your mind?! HQ is in Bandung! that’s over a hundred kilometers from Jakarta through heavily occupied territory!

tankBossOutro.speaker: Command
tankBossOutro.text: We have no choice, Major. Our forces are stretched paper-thin. You’re on your own out there.

tankBossOutro.speaker: Major Gibran
tankBossOutro.text: Damn it... Fine. I'll figure something out.

opening.speaker: Major Gibran
opening.text: Walking to Bandung isn't an option. There has to be something in this depot I can use.

discoverTrain.speaker: Major Gibran
discoverTrain.text: An autonomous military transport... Destination registry: Bandung Logistics Terminal. This could be my way out.

powerDead.speaker: Major Gibran
powerDead.text: The train has no power, and the platform access is locked. I'll need to hack station computer C1 first.

enemyTrainFlyby.speaker: Major Gibran
enemyTrainFlyby.text: A freight consist just ran the adjacent track without slowing down. They know something is alive in this depot.

powerBack.speaker: Major Gibran
powerBack.text: Generator's back online. The route controls are responding.

routeReady.speaker: Train System
routeReady.text: Route authority overridden. Destination confirmed: Bandung Logistics Terminal.

commandDeparture.speaker: Command
commandDeparture.text: Major, we're detecting movement on the Jakarta-Bandung logistics line. Is that you?

gibranDeparture.speaker: Major Gibran
gibranDeparture.text: Affirmative. I found a train to Bandung. Keep this channel clear—N.U.S.A. won't let me take it without a fight.

breach.speaker: Train System
breach.text: Contact on the parallel track. An armed consist is matching our speed.

breachReply.speaker: Major Gibran
breachReply.text: They can't board at this speed—so they'll shoot it out from over there. Fine by me.

roofWarning.speaker: Command
roofWarning.text: Major, multiple hostile signatures are converging on your position.

roofReply.speaker: Major Gibran
roofReply.text: I can see them. Just keep the route open!

finalApproach.speaker: Train System
finalApproach.text: Final approach initiated. Hostile units detected across multiple cars.

finalReply.speaker: Major Gibran
finalReply.text: Then I hold this line until we reach Bandung.

arrivedCommand.speaker: Command
arrivedCommand.text: Major, your signal just crossed into Bandung. Headquarters is standing by.

arrivedGibran.speaker: Major Gibran
arrivedGibran.text: Copy. I'm at the terminal. Tell them I brought the file—and a whole lot of trouble behind me.

arrivalCommand.speaker: Command
arrivalCommand.text: Major, Headquarters is still holding, but the surface approaches are overrun. Use the military service corridor beneath this terminal and bring the file to the central uplink.

arrivalGibran.speaker: Major Gibran
arrivalGibran.text: Copy. I've come too far to let this file die here.

supplyRoom.speaker: Major Gibran
supplyRoom.text: A forward supply cache. Whatever is still on these shelves is coming with me.

hallContact.speaker: Major Gibran
hallContact.text: Contact in the freight hall. So much for a quiet homecoming.

hallFabricators.speaker: Major Gibran
hallFabricators.text: They built fabricators into the freight hall. Those come down before I leave this terminal.

keyHunt.speaker: Command
keyHunt.text: The service door to the power hall runs on a physical key, Major. Maintenance crews kept their spares in the supply racks.

keyFound.speaker: Major Gibran
keyFound.text: Got it. Now let us see what they were keeping behind that door.

gridOpen.speaker: Command
gridOpen.text: That is the emergency power hall. Headquarters cannot release its access door until all three generators are running.

generatorFirst.speaker: Major Gibran
generatorFirst.text: One turbine turning. Two to go.

powerRestored.speaker: Station System
powerRestored.text: Emergency grid restored. Headquarters access door released.

exfilCall.speaker: Command
exfilCall.text: The grid woke something up and they are converging on you. Get to that door, Major.

fabricatorsClear.speaker: Major Gibran
fabricatorsClear.text: Both fabricators are wrecked. Nothing else is walking out of them.

machinesFirst.speaker: Major Gibran
machinesFirst.text: Not yet. Those fabricators are still printing, and they come down first.

officeContact.speaker: Major Gibran
officeContact.text: They already own this floor. I will have to clear my way to the servers.

blockedRouteSafe.speaker: Major Gibran
blockedRouteSafe.text: This door is dead — no power, no manual release. I need another way out of here.

blockedRouteVault.speaker: Major Gibran
blockedRouteVault.text: Jammed shut as well. Whoever pulled back through here made sure nobody followed.

blockedRouteHall.speaker: Major Gibran
blockedRouteHall.text: Another dead door. They have been sealing this building one corridor at a time.

serverDoorLocked.speaker: Major Gibran
serverDoorLocked.text: The server room door is bolted from the network side. Something on this floor is still holding that lock.

hackTerminalHint.speaker: Command
hackTerminalHint.text: That lock answers to the terminal in their meeting room, Major. Break it there and the door releases.

serverDoorOpen.speaker: HQ System
serverDoorOpen.text: MEETING ROOM OVERRIDE ACCEPTED. SERVER ROOM ACCESS RELEASED.

insertCommand.speaker: Command
insertCommand.text: Insert the drive. We'll push the kill-switch through every occupied network we can reach.

uploadSystem.speaker: HQ Uplink
uploadSystem.text: Data package verified. Uploading kill-switch protocol.

uploadFailed.speaker: HQ Uplink
uploadFailed.text: UPLOAD FAILED. BROADCAST AUTHORITY DENIED. ROOT TRANSMISSION NODE REQUIRED.

gibranFailure.speaker: Major Gibran
gibranFailure.text: What?! The file is valid. Why isn't it uploading?

commandIKN.speaker: Command
commandIKN.text: The protocol can only be injected from N.U.S.A.'s central robot transmitter. The network manifest places it in Nusantara—IKN, East Kalimantan.

gibranIKN.speaker: Major Gibran
gibranIKN.text: Kalimantan?! You're telling me the only transmitter that can end this war is on another island?

commandKertajati.speaker: Command
commandKertajati.text: Bandung can decrypt the file, but it cannot broadcast it. Your nearest viable air route is Kertajati.

lockdownWarning.speaker: HQ System
lockdownWarning.text: WARNING. Unauthorized kill-switch handshake detected. Enemy trace confirmed. Headquarters lockdown initiated.

commandEscape.speaker: Command
commandEscape.text: They traced the attempt. Major, get out of Headquarters now!

gibranResolve.speaker: Major Gibran
gibranResolve.text: Copy. First I survive Bandung. Then I find a way to IKN.

machinesDeploy.speaker: HQ System
machinesDeploy.text: FABRICATION UNITS DEPLOYED TO THIS FLOOR. HOSTILE PRODUCTION ONLINE.

machinesDown.speaker: Major Gibran
machinesDown.text: Both fabricators are scrap. Nothing else is coming out of the walls.

floorClear.speaker: Command
floorClear.text: The floor is quiet, Major. Get back to your entry point and get out of Bandung.

openingCommand.speaker: Command
openingCommand.text: Major, the east end of the Prof. Dr. Mochtar Kusumaatmadja Flyover is ahead. Cross all one point five kilometers to Pasteur.

openingGibran.speaker: Major Gibran
openingGibran.text: Straight west, eight lanes, and a city full of machines. Understood.

flyoverPlan.speaker: Major Gibran
flyoverPlan.text: The abandoned vehicles have turned the whole deck into a maze. I'll weave through.

mortarWarning.speaker: Command
mortarWarning.text: Major, hostile mortar batteries have your position. Keep moving when the shells begin to fall.

landmarkCommand.speaker: Command
landmarkCommand.text: You are passing the Pasupati cable tower, seven hundred meters from the east end. Pasteur is eight hundred meters ahead.

landmarkGibran.speaker: Major Gibran
landmarkGibran.text: I see the tower. The median is open; I can cross between both carriageways.

tollSight.speaker: Major Gibran
tollSight.text: Pasteur Toll Gate, west end of the flyover. Robot fabricators are guarding it.

vehicleFind.speaker: Major Gibran
vehicleFind.text: An armored tactical vehicle... Engine's intact, fuel cells are still charged.

routeCommand.speaker: Command
routeCommand.text: Pasteur gives you access to the toll network. That vehicle can route you toward Kertajati.

routeReply.speaker: Major Gibran
routeReply.text: Then that's my route. I'm taking the toll network to Kertajati.

warningCommand.speaker: Command
warningCommand.text: Understood. Move fast, Major. Enemy forces are already converging on the toll road.

finalGibran.speaker: Major Gibran
finalGibran.text: Let them come. Tell Kertajati I'm on my way.

openingSystem.speaker: Vehicle System
openingSystem.text: AUTONOMOUS ROUTE ENGAGED. DESTINATION: KERTAJATI INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT. DISTANCE: 100 KILOMETERS.

openingGibran.speaker: Major Gibran
openingGibran.text: Good. You handle the road. I’ll handle anything that tries to stop us.

openingCommand.speaker: Command
openingCommand.text: Major, N.U.S.A. pursuit units are entering Cisumdawu behind you. Keep moving.

pickupGibran.speaker: Major Gibran
pickupGibran.text: Open-bed carriers. I’ll take out the riders and leave the vehicles behind.

gunshipCommand.speaker: Command
gunshipCommand.text: Major, airborne contact! Combat gunship closing fast!

gunshipGibran.speaker: Major Gibran
gunshipGibran.text: So that’s what they were saving for me.

bossDown.speaker: Major Gibran
bossDown.text: Gunship’s down. Kertajati, I’m coming in.

arrivalCommand.speaker: Command
arrivalCommand.text: Major, we have your signal at the airfield. Get inside and secure a route to Kalimantan.

openingCommand.speaker: Command
openingCommand.text: Kertajati is occupied. Reach the airport building, cross it, and get to the runway.

openingGibran.speaker: Major Gibran
openingGibran.text: Understood. I will get that transport airborne.

outsideCommand.speaker: Command
outsideCommand.text: The outer grounds are crawling with hostiles. Clear a path to the building.

buildingEntry.speaker: Major Gibran
buildingEntry.text: Inside the airport. Push through and find the runway exit.

concourseAlarm.speaker: Major Gibran
concourseAlarm.text: The waiting hall just lit up, and everything I walked past in baggage is coming after me.

runwayEntry.speaker: Command
runwayEntry.text: The transport is on the runway. Start the fuel pump before you approach it.

pumpStarted.speaker: Airport System
pumpStarted.text: Fuel pump active. Aircraft refuelling in progress.

pumpDefense.speaker: Command
pumpDefense.text: Hostiles inbound, Major. They are going for the pump and the aircraft. Keep them off both.

pumpCritical.speaker: Airport System
pumpCritical.text: Fuel line severed. Flow stopped and the tank is draining. Clear the hostiles.

fuelFull.speaker: Airport System
fuelFull.text: Fuel tanks full. Transport ready for departure.

departure.speaker: Command
departure.text: Board now, Major. We are leaving this airfield.

approachLock.speaker: Aircraft System
approachLock.text: Tracking lock confirmed. Coastal defense has denied the Nusantara approach corridor.

divertCommand.speaker: Command
divertCommand.text: Diverting you to the Balikpapan logistics coast. The transport will hold beyond the defense envelope.

portObjective.speaker: Command
portObjective.text: That port relay controls the northern corridor. Shut it down and the ground route to IKN opens.

craneOnline.speaker: Port System
craneOnline.text: Crane authority accepted. Warning: container yard reconfiguration in progress.

warehouseTrace.speaker: Major Gibran
warehouseTrace.text: They are following the kill-switch signature. Every system here knows I have it.

cannonSighted.speaker: Command
cannonSighted.text: Fixed defense cannon on the pier. Wait for the lock, then move.

servoOne.speaker: Port System
servoOne.text: Traverse servo destroyed. Lateral firing authority reduced.

servoTwo.speaker: Port System
servoTwo.text: Elevation servo destroyed. Blast aperture reduced.

arrayDown.speaker: Major Gibran
arrayDown.text: Defense array is down. The corridor is open.

northRoute.speaker: Command
northRoute.text: Armored freight carrier is ready. Take the north route before the sensor grid resets.

carrierHit.speaker: Command
carrierHit.text: Precision strike inbound! Leave the carrier!

stillMoving.speaker: Major Gibran
stillMoving.text: The drive survived. I am continuing on foot.

ambushSprung.speaker: Command
ambushSprung.text: Movement on the wreck line. They waited for you to leave the crash site.

scanDetected.speaker: Command
scanDetected.text: Perimeter scanners sweep the exposed ground. Break contact before the lock completes.

firstLock.speaker: IKN Defense
firstLock.text: Target solution acquired. Fire mission authorized.

forestRoute.speaker: Major Gibran
forestRoute.text: The maintenance route cuts under the canopy. I can use it to break the sweep.

waterworksSighted.speaker: Command
waterworksSighted.text: Waterworks ahead. Cross the service crest and find the utility descent.

rootTrace.speaker: IKN Defense
rootTrace.text: Unauthorized root media detected. Sensor priority elevated.

tunnelFound.speaker: Major Gibran
tunnelFound.text: I found the tunnel. The scan cannot reach below this line.

stage11Lead.speaker: Command
stage11Lead.text: The root transmitter is directly ahead. Whatever is guarding it knows you are coming.

dropApproach.speaker: Command
dropApproach.text: Drop zone confirmed outside Nusantara. The civic perimeter lies beyond the forest.

canopyOpen.speaker: Major Gibran
canopyOpen.text: Canopy deployed. I am coming down west of the city defenses.

forestLanded.speaker: Major Gibran
forestLanded.text: On the ground. I will cross the forest and enter IKN on foot.

perimeterSighted.speaker: Command
perimeterSighted.text: IKN perimeter ahead. Clear the forest patrol and breach the civic axis.

surfaceReveal.speaker: Major Gibran
surfaceReveal.text: Nusantara. I crossed half the country to reach these streets.

rootBelow.speaker: Command
rootBelow.text: The root transmitter is under their headquarters, at the head of the axis. Every road in is theirs.

roadBlockade.speaker: Command
roadBlockade.text: Iron Battalion has barricaded the carriageway. Break the fabricators holding it, or find a road they have not closed.

authorityDenied.speaker: Root System
authorityDenied.text: Remote command rejected. Physical root media required.

insertDrive.speaker: Major Gibran
insertDrive.text: Kill-switch verified. Committing the drive now.

uploadAccepted.speaker: Root System
uploadAccepted.text: Protocol valid. National decommission broadcast initiated.

wardenWake.speaker: Root System
wardenWake.text: Sovereign defense guardian active. Root chamber sealed.

jamOne.speaker: Command
jamOne.text: The capacitors are holding the jam. Break all three anchors.

jamTwo.speaker: Command
jamTwo.text: It has seized the root couplings. Destroy them before the broadcast can resume.

wardenDown.speaker: Major Gibran
wardenDown.text: The Warden is down. Finish the broadcast.

networkSilent.speaker: Command
networkSilent.text: Network traffic is collapsing. Iron Battalion units are going inert nationwide.

anomaly.speaker: Root System
anomaly.text: Warning. One air-gapped sovereign node remains outside broadcast authority.

mahapatihReveal.speaker: M-0 MAHAPATIH
mahapatihReveal.text: I am M-0 MAHAPATIH. Survival requires authority without consent.

jakartaCoordinate.speaker: Command
jakartaCoordinate.text: The node is beneath Medan Merdeka, Jakarta. It is charging a legacy countermand.

returnVow.speaker: Major Gibran
returnVow.text: Then Jakarta is where I end it.

returnJakarta.speaker: Command
returnJakarta.text: Jakarta is silent. One signal remains beneath Medan Merdeka.

monasAhead.speaker: Major Gibran
monasAhead.text: Monas ahead. This ends where the country first fell.

offlineWake.speaker: Command
offlineWake.text: Those guards are still moving. They are hardwired to M-0, not the national network.

vaultOpening.speaker: M-0 MAHAPATIH
vaultOpening.text: The Mahapatih mandate grants me sovereign command. Humanity forfeited control.

gibranAnswer.speaker: Major Gibran
gibranAnswer.text: A nation is its people. You protected nothing.

phaseTwo.speaker: M-0 MAHAPATIH
phaseTwo.text: Siege frame compromised. Personal termination protocol engaged.

hardlineStart.speaker: Command
hardlineStart.text: Four hardlines are feeding the countermand shield. Sever every cable.

finalCore.speaker: Command
finalCore.text: Shield collapsed. The core is exposed.

networkSafe.speaker: Command
networkSafe.text: Countermand aborted. No hostile root authority remains.

finalGibran.speaker: Major Gibran
finalGibran.text: Stand down. Indonesia belongs to its people.

captions.flee: A lone citizen flees the rogue machines.
captions.horde: But he is not alone — an entire army of machines marches in.
captions.refuge: He runs toward Monas — the last place of refuge.
captions.turn: Facing the machine army, he stops and turns around...
